expected.text: Use the Slack APIs only as the contract and the Slack API documentation allow.

expected.text: An app offered to others outside our organization needs its own user agreement and privacy policy.

expected.text: The app's privacy policy must describe how we collect, use, store and share data in clear terms.

expected.text: Report any security incident involving Slack data to Slack promptly by email.
